info.title: Ricky API
info.description: REST API for one Ricky organization: contacts, conversations, messages, templates and webhooks. Requests and responses are JSON with snake_case fields; IDs are UUIDs except template IDs; times are ISO 8601 in UTC.

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description: People in the CRM and their custom fields.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: Threads with a contact on one channel: start, read, assign, close, reopen.

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Read and send messages, and follow each send.

tags.name: Catalogs
tags.description: Channels, members, tags and templates to reference by ID.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Subscriptions Ricky posts events to, and their deliveries.

post.description:
A contact sent a message.

Ricky signs every delivery: `X-Ricky-Signature: v1=<hex>` is the HMAC-SHA256 of `<X-Ricky-Timestamp>.<raw body>` keyed with the webhook `signing_secret`. Ricky sends it within seconds of the event. Answer any 2xx within 10 seconds; Ricky makes up to ten attempts with growing waits and may deliver an event twice, so deduplicate by `id`.

The provider accepted a message from the organization.

Ricky signs every delivery: `X-Ricky-Signature: v1=<hex>` is the HMAC-SHA256 of `<X-Ricky-Timestamp>.<raw body>` keyed with the webhook `signing_secret`. Ricky sends it within seconds of the event. Answer any 2xx within 10 seconds; Ricky makes up to ten attempts with growing waits and may deliver an event twice, so deduplicate by `id`.

An outbound message reached the recipient device.

Ricky signs every delivery: `X-Ricky-Signature: v1=<hex>` is the HMAC-SHA256 of `<X-Ricky-Timestamp>.<raw body>` keyed with the webhook `signing_secret`. Ricky sends it within seconds of the event. Answer any 2xx within 10 seconds; Ricky makes up to ten attempts with growing waits and may deliver an event twice, so deduplicate by `id`.

The recipient read an outbound message.

Ricky signs every delivery: `X-Ricky-Signature: v1=<hex>` is the HMAC-SHA256 of `<X-Ricky-Timestamp>.<raw body>` keyed with the webhook `signing_secret`. Ricky sends it within seconds of the event. Answer any 2xx within 10 seconds; Ricky makes up to ten attempts with growing waits and may deliver an event twice, so deduplicate by `id`.

An outbound message failed for good; read the message for the reason.

Ricky signs every delivery: `X-Ricky-Signature: v1=<hex>` is the HMAC-SHA256 of `<X-Ricky-Timestamp>.<raw body>` keyed with the webhook `signing_secret`. Ricky sends it within seconds of the event. Answer any 2xx within 10 seconds; Ricky makes up to ten attempts with growing waits and may deliver an event twice, so deduplicate by `id`.

A conversation was created or reopened.

Ricky signs every delivery: `X-Ricky-Signature: v1=<hex>` is the HMAC-SHA256 of `<X-Ricky-Timestamp>.<raw body>` keyed with the webhook `signing_secret`. Ricky sends it within seconds of the event. Answer any 2xx within 10 seconds; Ricky makes up to ten attempts with growing waits and may deliver an event twice, so deduplicate by `id`.

A conversation was closed.

Ricky signs every delivery: `X-Ricky-Signature: v1=<hex>` is the HMAC-SHA256 of `<X-Ricky-Timestamp>.<raw body>` keyed with the webhook `signing_secret`. Ricky sends it within seconds of the event. Answer any 2xx within 10 seconds; Ricky makes up to ten attempts with growing waits and may deliver an event twice, so deduplicate by `id`.

A conversation was assigned, reassigned or unassigned.

Ricky signs every delivery: `X-Ricky-Signature: v1=<hex>` is the HMAC-SHA256 of `<X-Ricky-Timestamp>.<raw body>` keyed with the webhook `signing_secret`. Ricky sends it within seconds of the event. Answer any 2xx within 10 seconds; Ricky makes up to ten attempts with growing waits and may deliver an event twice, so deduplicate by `id`.

A contact was created, by a person, the API, an import or a first message.

Ricky signs every delivery: `X-Ricky-Signature: v1=<hex>` is the HMAC-SHA256 of `<X-Ricky-Timestamp>.<raw body>` keyed with the webhook `signing_secret`. Ricky sends it within seconds of the event. Answer any 2xx within 10 seconds; Ricky makes up to ten attempts with growing waits and may deliver an event twice, so deduplicate by `id`.

A contact's fields, tags or custom values were saved.

Ricky signs every delivery: `X-Ricky-Signature: v1=<hex>` is the HMAC-SHA256 of `<X-Ricky-Timestamp>.<raw body>` keyed with the webhook `signing_secret`. Ricky sends it within seconds of the event. Answer any 2xx within 10 seconds; Ricky makes up to ten attempts with growing waits and may deliver an event twice, so deduplicate by `id`.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Do not parse it.

param.description: The request field or parameter that caused it.

request_id.description: Quote it to support. Also in the `X-Request-Id` header.

external_id.description: Address on that channel: phone digits for WhatsApp, account ID otherwise.

username.description: Handle on the channel, when it has one.

ContactIdentity.description: How a contact is reached on one channel.

examples: Prefiere que la contacten por la tarde.

custom_values.description: Custom field values keyed by contact field ID. See `GET /contact-fields`.

last_activity_at.description: Latest message in any of its conversations.

type.description: Value type: `number` takes a number, `boolean` a boolean, `date` `YYYY-MM-DD`, `select` one option, `multi_select` an array of options, the rest a string.

ContactField.description: A custom contact field defined by the organization.

address.description: Phone in E.164 for WhatsApp, account or page name otherwise.

whatsapp_business_account_id.description: WhatsApp Business Account that owns the number; templates must belong to it.

username.description: Handle, when the channel has one.

close_category.description: Why it was closed; null while open or when closed without one.

opened_at.description: Start of the current open span.

closed_at.description: When it was closed; null while open.

Conversation.description: One contact talking to the organization on one channel.

text.description: Text, caption or rendered template body.

type.description: `contact`; a `member` in Ricky; an AI `agent`; an `automation`; or `channel_app`, sent from the channel's own app outside Ricky.

name.description: Member, agent or workflow name; null for the contact and `channel_app`.

url.description: Signed download URL, valid for one hour; null until downloaded.

status.description: `sent` once the provider accepted the message; `failed` for good, with the reason; `queued` otherwise, while Ricky retries.

anyOf.description: The message in the conversation, once the provider accepted it; null before.

Send.description: An outbound message Ricky accepted and is delivering.

status.description: Meta review status. Only `APPROVED` templates can be sent.

components.description: Header, body, footer and buttons, in the WhatsApp Cloud API format.

examples.text: Hola {{1}}, tu pedido {{2}} está listo para retirar.

signing_secret.description: HMAC key for `X-Ricky-Signature`. Returned only here, once.

CreatedWebhook.description: A new webhook subscription with its signing secret.

id.description: Delivery ID; equals the event `id` and `X-Ricky-Delivery-Id`.

bearerAuth.description: An organization API key, `rky_live_…`, created in Settings → API. Send it only from a server.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional. A value you choose, unique per logical write, 8–200 characters: a UUID or an ID from your system such as `order-10482-ready`. Retrying with the same key and body replays the first response instead of repeating the write.

X-Request-Id.description: Request ID. Quote it to support.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time when the minute window resets.
